_about: ECONOMY [the contract's worth], rule 74. Contracts priced by skulls and distance, clout raising the pay, a failed one costing relation, the haggle and its cost. Pulled directly from the wiki's own Contracts and Relations pages (reference/library/grok/wiki/PAGES_ALL.tar.gz, bb_all/0441_Contracts.txt and GROK_118_UNDERBELLY_RELATIONS_2026_10_04.md citing https://battlebrothers.fandom.com/wiki/Relations), not Grok's secondhand summary where the primary page gave more. engine/bohemia_contracts.js is the mechanism; this file never computes. MECHANISM-MINE/CONTENTS-PAOLO'S: every number carries its source.

difficulty._about: contract difficulty is measured in skulls (easy/medium/hard on the page's own icons). More skulls means more danger AND better pay. The wiki page states this as a RULE, not a multiplier table -- no numeric skull-to-pay curve exists on the page this file pulled, matching price_table.json's own contractPay.skullScaling.sourced:false. Nothing invented here either.

renown._about: 'the crowns reward increases with your company's Renown. Some contracts, such as the noble houses contracts, are only available with a certain level of Renown.' Renown is CLOUT in our translation (rule 53). No renown-to-pay formula is stated on the page; flagged, not invented.

haggle._about: the full negotiation mechanic, pulled from the wiki page's own Haggling section (which itself cites a Steam developer post). Every number here is the wiki's, none felt.

relationsPenaltyPerAttempt.note: each haggle attempt costs relations whether it succeeds or fails, unless the Negotiator follower is hired

annoyance.note: annoyance accumulates whether the attempt succeeds or fails; you collect it BEFORE the roll

moreTotalPay.effect: increases the whole contract's value (completion, advance, per-head) by a random percentage
moreTotalPay.note: rounding can give slightly less than the rolled percent

payInAdvance.effect: subtracts 25% from completion AND per-head pay, adds it to the advance pay
payInAdvance.note: usually a net loss on rounding; the Negotiator increases how much can be asked in advance

payPerHead.effect: subtracts 25% from completion AND advance pay, adds it to the per-head pay
payPerHead.note: losing more than the max headcount loses money

haggle.source: bb_all/0441_Contracts.txt, Haggling section (itself citing a Steam developer post)

workedExampleWikiCrowns._about: the wiki page's own four real examples of the SAME contract under each haggle outcome, verbatim.

workedExampleBatteries._about: the same four rows at ten wiki crowns to one battery, floored (GROK_31/33). engine/bohemia_contracts.js derives these; kept here too as a fixed cross-check the gate can assert against without re-deriving the formula.
workedExampleBatteries.source: derived from workedExampleWikiCrowns at ten to one, floored (GROK_31/33); kept as a fixed cross-check, not recomputed

relationsCost._about: every relations change the wiki's own Relations and Factions-and-Relations pages state, not just contract failure. GROK_118 pulled these directly off https://battlebrothers.fandom.com/wiki/Relations.
relationsCost.note: the page does not state a bread-theft cost (Paolo's own ask, 'you cannot even steal bread in this game'); not filled in, named as missing rather than guessed

relationBands._about: for reading what a relation number MEANS, since a failed contract's -20 or -100 needs a scale to land on.
